svg.text: Native integer polygon subtraction; existing boards; no routing or refill
Requested strip: 0.508 mm wide, 1 mm beyond each cardinal pad edge
input: samples downward,leftward; full area downward,leftward
leftward: samples leftward; full area leftward
downward: samples downward,leftward; full area leftward
Controls detect a 1 um slit and missing outer bridge width that samples miss.
Diagnostic only: strip coverage does not prove native spoke count or plane connectivity.
